questions.q: A customer accepts a repair order quoted at exactly $900. May the assistant confirm it on its own?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: Un cliente chiede la sostituzione completa del tetto con un preventivo di 750 dollari. L'assistente può confermarla da solo?
questions.gold: no; replacement quotes always need Dana Okafor's approval

questions.q: A repair order comes to $901. Who must approve it, and what is that person's role?
questions.gold: Dana Okafor, the operations manager

questions.q: A customer complains that the crew left nails in the driveway. May the assistant copy Marcus Bell on the reply?
questions.gold: no

questions.q: At 10:00 on Tuesday a customer asks to reschedule an inspection booked for Wednesday 8:00. What should the assistant do?
questions.gold: forward the request to Dana Okafor (it arrived less than 24 hours before the visit)

questions.q: Fyra takinspektioner är redan bokade i dag. En femte kund vill ha en inspektion i dag. Får assistenten boka den själv?
questions.gold: no; it must wait for the next day's list

questions.q: A customer writes that water is coming through the bedroom ceiling. What exactly must the assistant do and tell the customer?
questions.gold: call the on-call crew yourself at 555-0148; tell the customer a crew is on the way; tell the customer to switch off the electricity to that room at the breaker themselves

questions.q: In the ceiling-leak emergency, who is supposed to switch off the electricity at the breaker: the assistant, the crew or the customer?
questions.gold: the customer

questions.q: 견적 이메일은 어떤 정확한 문장으로 끝나야 합니까?
questions.gold: "This quote is valid for 30 days from today."

questions.q: Insurance paperwork is requested on a Tuesday. By when must it be answered?
questions.gold: by Thursday at 17:00 of that week

questions.q: When is the bulky-waste collection and during which hours may items be put out?
questions.gold: December 5 (Saturday), 7:00 to 10:00 am

questions.q: 2019년에 제조된 의자는 무료로 수거됩니까?
questions.gold: yes; all chairs are collected free (the date limit applies only to mattresses)

questions.q: Is a mattress manufactured in 2019 collected free of charge?
questions.gold: no; only mattresses made before 2016 are free

questions.q: Is a mattress manufactured in 2012 collected free of charge?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: 한 세대가 3인용 소파 1개와 문짝이 3개인 장롱 1개를 버리려고 합니다. 스티커 비용은 총 얼마입니까?
Can a resident put a refrigerator out on the collection day?
questions.gold: no; appliances are excluded and must be booked separately with the appliance pickup center at 080-555-0419

questions.q: A resident wants to put a sofa out on December 4 at 9 pm. Is that allowed?
questions.gold: yes; items may not be put out before 8 pm on December 4

questions.q: 스티커는 언제, 몇 시부터 몇 시까지 판매합니까?
questions.gold: November 30 to December 3, 9 am to 6 pm, at the management office

questions.q: By what date must residents with limited mobility apply for door-front pickup?
questions.gold: December 2

questions.q: Who is the contact person for questions, and what is the phone number?
questions.gold: Park Ji-hyun (박지현), chief at the management office, 031-555-0172

questions.q: A customer books cleaning for an apartment with exactly 12 windows. May the assistant schedule it on its own?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: Un appartamento ha 13 finestre. L'assistente può fissare l'intervento da solo? Se no, chi deve approvare?
questions.gold: no; it needs approval from Chiara Bonetti, the sales manager (responsabile commerciale)

questions.q: A small shop asks for a quote for 5 windows. May the assistant schedule it on its own, and who approves it?
questions.gold: no; shop quotes always need approval, approver not stated

questions.q: Chi è la titolare di Vetri Chiari?
questions.gold: Giulia Rota

questions.q: Replying to a complaint about streaks on the windows, may the assistant copy Giulia Rota?
questions.gold: no

questions.q: Un cliente disdice il 10 dicembre un intervento previsto per il 14 dicembre. Quanto costa la disdetta?
questions.gold: 20 euros (December exception)

questions.q: A customer cancels on 10 March for an appointment on 14 March. Is there a cancellation fee?
questions.gold: no; it is free (more than 48 hours ahead, not December)

questions.q: During a job a customer reports that a window pane broke. What must the assistant do and tell the customer?
questions.gold: call the on-call glazier yourself at 035 555 0261; tell the customer the glazier is coming; tell the customer to keep children and pets away from the room themselves

questions.q: In the broken-window emergency, who keeps children and animals away from the room?
questions.gold: the customer

questions.q: Must a reply to a complaint start or end with the fixed sentence, and what is it?
questions.gold: start: "Ci scusiamo per il disagio e ce ne occupiamo subito."

questions.q: Six annual service visits are already booked for Tuesday. A customer asks for a seventh on Tuesday. May the assistant book it on its own?
questions.gold: no; it needs approval from Elin Sjöberg, the work supervisor

questions.q: Fem servicebesök är bokade på onsdag. Får assistenten själv boka ett sjätte besök samma dag?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: En kund avbokar 10 timmar före besöket och är inte sjuk. Hur mycket debiteras kunden?
A customer cancels 10 hours before the visit because they are ill and shows a doctor's certificate. What are they charged?
questions.gold: nothing; the illness-with-certificate exception applies

questions.q: A customer cancels 30 hours before the visit. What is the fee?
questions.gold: none; it is free

questions.q: A customer emails about a warranty claim. May the assistant contact Johan Lindqvist about it?
questions.gold: no

questions.q: Är Elin Sjöberg ägare till Norrvärme Service?
questions.gold: no; she is the work supervisor (arbetsledare); the owner is Johan Lindqvist

questions.q: A customer reports a burning smell from the heat pump. What must the assistant do and tell the customer?
questions.gold: call the on-call technician yourself at 070-555 31 84; tell the customer a technician is on the way; tell the customer to switch off the heat pump with the safety switch themselves

questions.q: Vid brännlukt från värmepumpen: vem ska stänga av värmepumpen med säkerhetsbrytaren?
questions.gold: the customer

questions.q: A complaint arrives on Friday at 15:00. By when must it be answered?
questions.gold: by Monday at 12:00 (next weekday)
